Footer Snippet Generator

Generate a multi-column website footer — live preview plus copy-ready HTML and CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your brand, tagline and footer columns ("Title|Link1|Link2").
  2. Add social links and copyright text.
  3. Preview the footer live.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained footer.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the column format?

One column per line: "Column title|Link one|Link two|Link three". Up to 4 columns are used.

How are social links formatted?

One per line as "Label|https://…" — e.g. "Twitter|https://twitter.com/acme".

Is it responsive?

Yes — columns stack vertically on small screens.

Can I embed it in my page?

Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with ft- to avoid collisions.
